```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
list.files(
  path       = "R",
  pattern    = "\\.R$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  grep(x       = _,
       pattern = "^R\\/_",
       value   = TRUE,
       invert  = TRUE) |>
  sapply(FUN = source) |>
  invisible()

```
